name: Volunteer hours
task: Given scanned paper sign-ins, a scheduling export, and a spreadsheet of self-reported hours, produce a reconciled hours ledger and a funder-metric rollup.
gates: every conflict between sources surfaced rather than silently resolved
score: exact match on rollup totals + recall on conflict detection
why_agents_fail_today: Failure is ingestion/OCR and source-conflict handling, not reasoning. Most mechanically tractable of the five.
economic_value: Coordinator time; feeds grant reporting since volunteer hours are frequently a required funder metric. Smallest dollar opportunity, fastest to working.
